reviews.content: @TheCompany Your chatbot just kept copy-pasting the same steps without actually answering my questions. I asked 3 times about the magic link, account connections, and profile order — got nada but a boring loop. Frustrating and useless 🙄 #Fail
reviews.headline: Bot stuck on repeat, zero answers, total fail

reviews.content:
Hello,

I am struggling to complete onboarding due to unclear instructions about accepting workspace invites, confirming if the magic link was successfully used, and how to connect multiple social accounts properly. The chatbot repeatedly provided the same generic steps without addressing my specific questions or confirming if clicking the magic link multiple times is safe. It also did not clarify the order of creating profiles versus connecting accounts, which led to confusion and getting stuck when scheduling posts.

Please provide detailed, actionable instructions for these steps and advise on how to escalate this issue to human support promptly if the problem persists. I can provide the conversation transcript if needed.

Thank you.
reviews.headline: Request for clear onboarding guidance and issue escalation

reviews.content: I kept asking how to confirm if the magic link invite actually worked and whether I could connect TikTok and LinkedIn at the same time. The chatbot just gave me the same generic 4-step list over and over without answering any of my real concerns. It left me super confused and stuck in onboarding. Also, no help on whether I should create the profile before or after connecting accounts. Really frustrating experience for a beginner like me.
reviews.headline: Chatbot stuck on repeat, never helped with real questions

reviews.content: Ugh, just had the worst onboarding chat ever. I kept asking basic stuff — does clicking the magic link show confirmation? Can I connect TikTok and LinkedIn at the same time? When do I make the profile? The bot just repeated the same 4-step thing like a stuck record. Didn’t address any of my follow-ups or explain anything new. So annoying. Almost gave up completely. Feels like it’s designed to waste time, not help.
reviews.headline: Bot acting like a broken record, zero real help

reviews.content:
Hi,

I’m disappointed to say I’m cancelling because the onboarding process was confusing and support was unhelpful. The chatbot kept repeating the same generic steps without answering my detailed questions about accepting the invite, connecting multiple social accounts, or profile creation order. It never clarified if clicking the magic link multiple times was safe or how to confirm successful connection. This left me stuck and frustrated with no clear next steps or easy access to human help.

I hope you improve this soon for future users.
reviews.headline: Leaving due to poor onboarding support and unclear instructions

reviews.content: @Company The chatbot nailed giving me exact instructions for invite and revoke controls in settings — no guesswork. Still wish the revoke flow was less click-heavy. At least they’re open to requests! 👍 #UX
reviews.headline: Clear steps for invite controls but could be sleeker

reviews.content:
Subject: Request to simplify revoke invite process in Members settings

Hello,

I used the chatbot to locate invite and revoke invite controls within workspace settings. Instructions were clear and easy to follow. However, the revoke invite flow remains multi-step and inefficient.

Please consider adding a one-click “Revoke” button for pending invites to speed up this common task. The chatbot also offered to file a support ticket on my behalf. I am including the transcript of our conversation for reference.

Thank you for your attention to this usability improvement.

Best regards,
Product Owner / Team Lead #4
reviews.headline: Request to streamline revoke invite workflow

reviews.content: The chatbot provided very clear, step-by-step guidance to find invite and revoke invite controls in settings, which was exactly what I needed. I especially appreciated the offer to file a feature request for a quicker revoke option. The current revoke invite flow still feels unnecessarily clunky, so I gave 4 stars. If that improve, it would be perfect.
reviews.headline: Clear invite instructions but revoke needs less friction
